## 1.0 CATS Time Tracking Tool

Time tracking should be _done daily_ at the end of the day to ensure accurate record keeping. It is critical to ensure that _time is entered for the month before month end_, as late entries after the deadline require using the corrective reporting process (links below). This daily practice helps maintain compliance with organizational time tracking requirements and avoids the need for time corrections.

## 2.0 OpEx WBS Codes

**OpEx (Operational Expenditure)** refers to the ongoing, day-to-day expenses required to run the business and maintain current operations. These are recurring costs for regular business activities, maintenance, and operational support.

| Code | Category          | WBS Number              | Use For                                                               |
| ---- | ----------------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 2.1  | **EAP Core**      | I.000042.01.01.05.01.01 | Architecture, Application, Practice Overview, Guiding Principles work |
| 2.2  | **EAP Training**  | I.000042.01.01.05.01.02 | Internal and external training activities                             |
| 2.3  | **EAP Processes** | I.000042.01.01.05.01.03 | Process-related work, e.g., Governance                                |

## 3.0 CapEx WBS Codes

**CapEx (Capital Expenditure)** refers to funds used to acquire, upgrade, or maintain physical assets and infrastructure. These are investments in long-term assets that will provide value over multiple years, such as new systems, major upgrades, or significant infrastructure improvements.

| Code | Category                  | WBS Number      | Use For                                         |
| ---- | ------------------------- | --------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| 3.1  | **EAP CapEx Initiatives** | _Not Available_ | Currently no CapEx WBS codes are set up for EAP |

## 4.0 CATS Field Entry

When entering time in the SAP CATS system, specific field values must be used to ensure proper categorization and reporting of EAP activities. The table below provides the required values for each field, along with guidance on which fields should be left blank or are not required for EAP time tracking.

| Field                    | Value                             | Notes                              |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| **Receiver WBS Element** | Enter appropriate WBS# from above | Use codes from sections 2.0 or 3.0 |
| **A/A Type**             | YA01                              | Standard value for EAP activities  |
| **Billing Material**     | _Leave blank_                     | Not required for EAP time tracking |
| **Initiative**           | _Leave blank_                     | Field not used for EAP activities  |
| **Work Category**        | STRAT ROADMAP-INVEST              | Standard category for all EAP work |
| **Work Description**     | _Leave blank_                     | Field not used for EAP activities  |

### Example

Here is an example of how these fields appear in the CATS system:

![CATS Time Entry Example](./assets/cats-time-entry.png)

Once you have entered your time, ensure to save and submit your timesheet for approval as per organizational procedures. You can also save your current time entries as a template so next week the WBS codes and other fields are pre-populated. Look for the _Save As Template_ menu option.

![CATS Time Entry Example](./assets/cats-time-save-template.png)
